weather_report:
Late morning in Subiaco and the sky has settled into a clear, luminous blue, the earlier patchwork of cloud already dissolved. Sunlight feels generous yet tempered by October, casting crisp edges on stone and pine; visibility is clean, the sort of clarity that brings the hills a touch nearer. Expect an open, bright day with little to interrupt the shine. Around midday the sun will still carry a modest sting, so think sunglasses, a bit of sunscreen, and a hat, even if the air itself stays kindly on the skin.

This is easy-weather—pleasant for unhurried errands on foot, airing out the rooms, or a quiet stroll along a familiar lane before lunch. Dress in light layers you can shrug off as the afternoon ripens, and comfortable shoes that invite a meander. If you’d rather linger, claim a sunlit bench with a book, sort the week’s shopping at a small grocer, or tend a few balcony plants while the sky holds its calm, blue promise.
